objective: Compare a fixed TVD detector with an isolated pooled-label permutation statistic for synthetic simulator healthy-control false positives and sensitivity to parameter-shift program faults.

evidence_boundary.frozen_heldout_acceptance: excluded; no outcomes, labels, thresholds, or expectations may be used for development selection
evidence_boundary.previous_finite_shot_calibration_and_val: excluded from new train/calibration/validation observations; existing summaries may motivate the question only
evidence_boundary.three_family_reference_fixture: engineering fixture only; excluded from fresh development and validation
evidence_boundary.independent_truth: simulator intervention labels are known by construction and remain synthetic; no independent truth or hardware claim

family_sampling.target_frame: new simulator-generated circuit families with a supported measured single-qubit RY operation, sampled from a versioned, reviewable finite family frame
family_sampling.family_root_definition: canonical ordered gate-name/qubit topology before any fault intervention; angle values, sampling seeds, repetitions, shot levels, and injected mutations are descendants within that root
family_sampling.family_unit: unique canonical circuit topology root; seeds, angle variants, repetitions, shot counts, and mutations remain descendants of that single root
exclusion_rules: reject duplicate topology roots across new families
exclude all known old finite-shot, reference-generalization, controlled-fault, full-dataset, and frozen-acceptance roots
family_sampling.partition_rule: assign complete family roots to development or validation before generating outcome counts; never split descendants

conditions.repetition_unit: paired sampled reference and submitted circuit executions; repetitions are repeated measures within a family, not independent families
conditions.random_seed_policy: derive deterministic per-family/stratum/shot/repetition seeds from the frozen master seed and lineage root; do not reuse prior campaign seeds

candidate.name: pooled_label_TVD_permutation
candidate.test_alpha_selection: choose the largest alpha in [0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.10] whose development healthy-control empirical false-positive rate is at most 0.05; if none qualifies, classify the candidate unsuccessful and do not evaluate on validation

methods.candidate_settings_freeze: write and hash selected alpha and method settings before opening validation outcomes
methods.statistical_assumption: permutation p-value is interpretable under independent, exchangeable shot outcomes between reference and submitted samples; it is not a fault probability

primary: sensitivity separately for subtle, moderate, and strong strata, at each shot count
outcomes.comparison: paired baseline/candidate decisions on identical sampled counts; aggregate by family and report paired family-level differences
outcomes.uncertainty: report exact binomial descriptive intervals per cell and family-cluster bootstrap intervals for paired differences; label intervals exploratory because only eight validation family clusters are planned
outcomes.abstention: the candidate statistic itself has no abstention output; report an abstention only when the independent protocol/evidence disposition is ambiguous or execution is invalid, and do not force a single-cause label
outcomes.attribution_localization: not evaluated; detection results do not establish program/hardware causal attribution or source localization

provisional_development_decision_rules.status: directional pilot rules only; not approved acceptance criteria and not suitable for release, publication, or confirmatory claims
provisional_development_decision_rules.promising: on fresh validation families, candidate aggregate healthy-control FPR is lower than baseline and candidate sensitivity is no lower in every predefined fault stratum; family-cluster uncertainty is still reported and no population-level claim follows
provisional_development_decision_rules.unsuccessful: candidate is not selectable under the development-only alpha rule, or validation FPR is no lower than baseline and sensitivity is no higher in every fault stratum
provisional_development_decision_rules.inconclusive: all other outcomes, insufficient valid independent families, missing/invalid cells, or family-cluster intervals compatible with both benefit and harm
provisional_development_decision_rules.restriction: these relative directional categories are pilot triage only; no absolute performance floor is asserted

stop_rules: stop before a reservation that would exceed any circuit, shot, or output cap
stop immediately when runtime or peak-memory cap is crossed
stop and preserve a partial manifest on any provenance, lineage, seed, or output-integrity failure
do not resume across changed source/configuration hashes
resource_limits.authorization: no execution authorization is implied by this plan

blocker.reason: The resource-bounded scan covered the six primary source/data/evidence roots and retained prior temp-output roots: 20,000 artifacts / 124,638,914 bytes across 108 roots, then stopped at its file cap; five oversized files were skipped. It found 5,366 circuit-like records, 5,186 unknown-lineage records, three observed recipe roots, and six source-declared possible design_recipe roots, of which only three were observed in saved rows. Six cross-artifact root/family review flags remain unresolved. Inventory completeness is therefore explicitly false; no families are eligible.
required_before_generation: independently reconcile all remaining files after the deterministic 20,000-file/128-MiB scan cap and five oversized files
resolve missing per-template roots, ancestry and fingerprints or conservatively account for all affected records
review six cross-artifact root/family flags and reconcile all six source-declared roots against saved descendants
obtain hash-bound independent completeness attestation and at least 16 genuinely fresh, disjoint roots
validate unchanged plan against current source/runtime and obtain separate execution authorization
blocker.current_disposition: No circuit or shot data generated; provenance inventory/frame only; zero eligible roots; no candidate threshold selected; no study run.
